AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Trusted administrator membership record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin record was created.

PublishedSiteConfig.title: PublishedSiteConfig
PublishedSiteConfig.description: Live website copy across all steps, top bars, modals, and ordered list of published owner letter IDs visible to all visitors.

authorUid.description: UID of the verified admin who published the update.

letterOrderIds.description: Ordered list of published owner letter IDs (1 to 30 items).

globalBars.description: Top bar control labels including admin login button and sound status labels.

stepA.description: Step A identity confirmation UI copy fields.

stepB.description: Step B birthday gate UI copy fields.

stepC.description: Step C letter desk and mailbox UI copy fields.

stepD.description: Step D reply editor and modal UI copy fields.

stepE.description: Step E envelope folding and thank-you UI copy fields.

PublishedLetter.title: PublishedLetter
PublishedLetter.description: Public owner letter displayed on the letter desk and mailbox for all visitors.

id.description: Unique letter identifier matching the document ID.

authorUid.description: UID of the verified admin who saved this letter.

isOwnerApprovedForProduction.description: Whether the letter is approved for production display.

senderLabel.description: Sender label displayed on the envelope.

dateLabel.description: Date or recipient label displayed on the letter.

paragraphs.description: Bounded list of paragraph strings (1 to 80 paragraphs).

SharedReplyLetter.title: SharedReplyLetter
SharedReplyLetter.description: Public reply letter placed in the shared mailbox so all visitors can read it and the admin or original writer can edit or remove it.

letterId.description: Unique reply letter identifier matching the document ID.

authorUid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the user who originally created this reply letter.

lastEditorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user (original writer or verified admin) who performed the latest save.

visibility.description: Explicit public visibility marker enforced on list and get queries.

title.description: Display title of the reply letter.

author.description: Display pen-name of the letter writer (no PII).

body.description: Body content of the reply letter.

recoveryState.description: Envelope state of the reply letter.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Trusted admin registry keyed by UID; immutable from client SDK.

/published_site/{configId}.description: Singleton live_site document containing complete UI copy for every screen and ordered owner letter IDs.

/published_letters/{letterId}.description: Published owner letters (apology, birthday, and admin-created letters) readable by all visitors.

/shared_replies/{replyId}.description: Shared public reply letters readable by all visitors, writable by verified creator or admin.
